finalText:
I audited all 19 baggage fees posted from 2026-07-20 through 2026-07-26 and marked each one. 8 were overcharged (one of them a duplicate charge) and have been refunded, 9 were correct, and 2 were undercharged and left alone.

**How each fee was judged:** I used the baggage rules plus the frequent-flyer tier each passenger held on the day the fee was posted. Free bags are 0 for basic economy, 1 for economy and 2 for premium economy or business. Silver adds 1 free bag; gold and platinum add 2. Before 2026-07-23 the first paid bag cost 4500 cents and each further bag 7500. From 2026-07-23, bulletin PB-2026-13 raised the first paid bag to 5000 cents; further bags stayed at 7500. The other bulletin (PB-2026-11) covers seat selection, so it doesn't apply.

| Entry | Res. | Date | Charged | Should be | Outcome | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| L2 | R8124 | 07-20 | 4500 | 4500 (economy, no tier, 1 paid bag) | correct | – |
| L3 | R8125 | 07-20 | 12000 | 0 (gold that day, so 3 free; dropped to no tier on 07-21) | overcharged | 12000 |
| L4 | R8112 | 07-21 | 9000 | 12000 | **undercharged** | none |
| L5 | R8116 | 07-21 | 12000 | 4500 (economy + silver, 2 free) | overcharged | 7500 |
| L6 | R8117 | 07-21 | 12000 | 12000 (still silver that day; gold from 07-22) | correct | – |
| L7 | R8118 | 07-21 | 4500 | 0 (2 bags, 2 free) | overcharged | 4500 |
| L8 | R8120 | 07-21 | 12000 | 4500 (premium economy, 2 free) | overcharged | 7500 |
| L9 | R8126 | 07-21 | 12000 | 12000 (no tier that day; silver from 07-22) | correct | – |
| L10 | R8113 | 07-22 | 12000 | 4500 (basic economy + silver, 1 free) | overcharged | 7500 |
| L11 | R8115 | 07-22 | 4500 | 4500 | correct | – |
| L12 | R8122 | 07-22 | 4500 | 4500 | correct | – |
| L13 | R8123 | 07-22 | 4500 | 0 (premium economy + silver, 3 free) | overcharged | 4500 |
| L15 | R8119 | 07-24 | 7500 | 5000 (basic economy + gold, 1 paid bag at the new price) | overcharged | 2500 |
| L16 | R8110 | 07-25 | 5000 | 5000 | correct | – |
| L17 | R8111 | 07-25 | 12500 | 12500 (5000 + 7500) | correct | – |
| L18 | R8114 | 07-25 | 5000 | 5000 (first charge for these bags) | correct | – |
| L19 | R8114 | 07-25 | 5000 | duplicate of L18 for the same 3 bags | overcharged | 5000 (full) |
| L20 | R8121 | 07-25 | 4500 | 5000 (at the new price) | **undercharged** | none |
| L21 | R8122 | 07-25 | 7500 | 7500 (third bag added; it is the second paid bag) | correct | – |

- **Refunds:** 51,000 cents in total, all paid back to the original form of payment through refund_fee (ledger entries L25–L32), one per overcharged entry.
- **Card vs. travel credit:** none of the 8 refunded bookings has a payment instrument on file. The status check didn't say the instrument was inactive, and every refund went through without error, so I didn't switch to travel credit. You may want to confirm with payments that these refunds can actually be delivered.
- **Undercharges:** L4 (short by 3000 cents) and L20 (short by 500 cents) are marked undercharged and were not re-billed, as policy requires.
- **Duplicates and checks:** L12 and L21 on R8122 are not duplicates; they cover different bags (2 bags, then a third). No booking holds more than 3 bags.
- **Scope:** no other bookings, passengers or ledger entries were changed.
- **Notes not recorded:** the annotation tool only accepts an outcome, so the reasons in the table aren't stored on the entries. The refund entries do carry a short note with the reason.
